data.provenance: Existing authored synthetic software fixture; owner-approved pipeline development, no task-quality inference

failures.reason: Existing encoderRound rejects shift one because its lower-bit slice is empty; the new circuit now uses roundHalf for this case.
Test used a slash in the existing dotted quantization schema identifier; corrected only the test fixture.
Resolving the virtual-environment Python symlink invoked its base interpreter without py-ecc. Three proofs were generated; no independent verification result was obtained.

hypothesis: A model-specific byte lookup and integer-sum circuit can prove the complete native decisions of freshly trained, exported MLPs without embedding a virtual machine or hand-substituting marker weights.
limitations: Width-four byte-histogram MLP on authored markers; 80 epochs without convergence, no real safety-quality or calibration result
Proof capacities eight and 1024 bytes; native 32768-byte profile maximum is not proved here
Complete inference includes input commitment, learned affine constants, nearest-even rounding, ReLU, chunk maximum and strict threshold; no general-purpose VM
Research controller and separate arithmetic implementation are unaudited; local setup is not accepted operational custody or a hiding/security qualification
No full hybrid acceptance, authenticated response generation, or hardware evidence
Timings are diagnostic runs, not performance distributions or a cross-backend speed comparison

validation.scope: Runtime source validated after both proof campaigns; final evidence/prose and exact-head CI are separate delivery checks
